description: The pie chart represents the distribution of categories or levels, comparing their proportions. The chart is divided into three slices. The largest slice, labeled "Level2 - 12.1" and colored medium blue, occupies approximately 44.32% of the chart. The second-largest slice, labeled "Level1 - 8.2" and colored light blue, accounts for around 30.04%. The smallest slice, labeled "Level3 - 7.0" and colored dark blue, represents about 25.64%. The percentage labels are displayed inside or next to each slice. The "Level2 - 12.1" slice is visually emphasized by being offset or exploded from the rest of the chart. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice starting from the center-left.
